expectedEvents.text:
No, 9.11 is **not** greater than 9.9. 

Here is why:
* If you equalize the decimal places, you are comparing **9.11** to **9.90**.
* Since 9.90 (or 9.9) has a 9 in the tenths place
while 9.11 has a 1 in the tenths place, **9.9 is larger than 9.11**.
